system.effect:
You become Trained in Awareness. Create one 1-foot manifestation in an unoccupied square within 6 feet; it lasts until encounter end, you are Unconscious, or it is dismissed. You may have only one. It has Speed 6 feet and no independent actions. Command ❶ on your Opportunity to make it either Move up to its Speed or Strike an adjacent creature (Zoned Blow, 1d4 damage, using the chosen parent’s attack bonus). It uses your Evade or Guard when attacked and vanishes on a Hit; Graze does not dismiss it. It cannot use Reactions, Bind, Intercept, provide Support, or inflict Wounds. It never rolls Damage Dice for its Strike. Its form is cosmetic unless a Talent specifies otherwise.

If this is your first Calling, you also gain 6 Vigor and Training in Elementalism, or Forceweaving, Vitalism, Mindweaving, or Spiritcraft.

NEEDS Expert/Master/Legendary increases.
